scope: Ntgre only; independent external runtimes are outside this recursive count

verification.mode: Fresh read-only AWS template and physical-identity comparison

method: Every CloudFormation declaration counted once including nested handles and metadata. Model stack resources/handles assigned to their model; custom resolver/auth stages assigned by operation; shared providers, handlers and multi-domain APIs retained as CORE / SHARED. Counts are ownership attribution, not transplantable deployments.
